question: On the publishing side of this project's apt channel: where do packages get published to, how many old versions are kept, what identity does the repository advertise in its release metadata, and where in the tree does the distribution index live? Cite path:line for each.
answer:
Packages are published to the GitHub repo `namastex888/fde-station-apt` (channel/publish.sh:52 — `REPO_SLUG`), pushed to `origin/main` (publish.sh:293 — `git push -q -u origin main`). Consumers fetch immutable SHA-pinned content from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/$REPO_SLUG/$SHA/` (publish.sh:296).

Old versions kept: defaults to 2 per package, configurable via the `KEEP` env var (publish.sh:56 — `KEEP="${KEEP:-2}"`). The `prune_pool` function (publish.sh:188‑200) drops everything beyond the `$KEEP` threshold.

The repository advertises this release identity in the `Release` file (generated at publish.sh:225‑252):
- `Origin: FDE Station` (publish.sh:59 — `ORIGIN`)
- `Label: FDE Station` (publish.sh:60 — `LABEL`)
- `Suite: stable` (publish.sh:61 — `SUITE`)
- `Codename: stable` (publish.sh:62 — `CODENAME`)
- `Component: main` (publish.sh:63 — `COMPONENT`)

The distribution index lives under `dists/stable/` within the working clone (`CHANNEL_DIR`):
- `dists/stable/Release` (publish.sh:175 and line 226 — `DIST_DIR="dists/$SUITE"`, `rel="$DIST_DIR/Release"`)

- `dists/stable/main/binary-amd64/Packages.gz` (publish.sh:222)
